analogy.rationale: GSK3 inhibitors act within the Wnt/kinase signaling network and share substrates/overlap with CDKs and other serine-threonine kinases, so CDK inhibitors and related kinase inhibitors should give the most similar transcriptional responses. GSK3 is broadly expressed, so a moderate rather than strong response is expected.
